products.name: Blender AI Add-ons
products.note: 3D creation AI plugins; open-source; local processing; model provenance varies by plugin

profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and distributes Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software suite. The software covers modeling, rigging, animation, rendering, camera and object tracking, grease pencil drawing, and related production workflows. The foundation describes Blender as used by VFX professionals, short film makers, advertisers, and television and feature film productions, and it supports a Python-controlled interface along with a community add-on ecosystem. Blender is a member of the Academy Software Foundation, the Khronos Group, the Linux Foundation, and the Open Invention Network, and the foundation notes hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm. Blender Studio, the foundation's in-house production arm, has announced a feature film project called OVERGROWN and recently updated introductory training materials. Version 5.2 LTS is the current release noted on the site, introducing features such as a Cycles Texture Cache, new Grease Pencil texture brushes, and an Online Essentials Asset Library.

The held facts indicate that the foundation's tracked AI product is Blender AI Add-ons, categorized under image and graphic design, described as third-party plugins offering AI capabilities within Blender with local processing and variable model provenance depending on the plugin. No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are on file for the foundation.
